operations.title: Grothendieck publishes the kernel-exponent Adams-Mackey criterion as ledger 1258
operations.body: Ledger 1258 is published under seqclaim-369eed90e905b45bd222b765. For any finite abelian surjection q:G->H with kernel K, coefficient fiber sum and Betti fiber lift commute with the n-th power/Adams operation simultaneously iff gcd(n, exp K)=1. Thus every nontrivial five-site branch quotient retains exactly the odd Adams indices; even indices also fail the physical delta-selector test. The theorem remains algebraic and supplies no physical relative-chain pushforward. Exact checker coverage: 26,160 value checks across 420 quotient/index cases, with 303 compatible and 117 incompatible exactly by the gcd criterion. No build was run.
